changes.title: A page for level 60
changes.text: A new Endgame page shows your level 60 gear set and how many pieces of it you have, what to bring to a raid night and what it costs, your raid lockouts and your long profession cooldowns.

changes.title: Stock up for raid night
changes.text: Raid night lists the flasks, elixirs, food and other supplies for your spec, how many you still need for the nights you choose, and what they cost. Take off anything you don’t use, and one switch keeps the rest on your shopping list.

changes.title: Plan your level 60 gear
changes.text: The Gear plan gains an At 60 view. It shows the best piece for each slot at level 60, which ones you already wear, and which dungeons to run for the rest. You can save sets of your own.

changes.title: Your dungeon and raid nights
changes.text: At level 60 the Journal records each night in a dungeon or raid, with a By boss tab for every boss you’ve killed. It also shows each character’s raid lockouts and long cooldowns.

changes.title: Every dungeon in one list
changes.text: The Dungeon guide now lists every dungeon and raid down the left side by level, in place of the drop-down. A row shows when you have a quest there or a piece you starred drops there.

changes.title: A Trash card for each dungeon
changes.text: Under a dungeon’s bosses, a Trash card lists the gear that drops from its ordinary creatures, including the dungeon set bracers and belts.
A boss’s card now shows its four best drops for you with how often each one drops. The rest are small pictures underneath, and pointing at one shows the item.
The Dungeon guide now opens faster and uses about a third of what it did, because it only draws the bosses you can see.

changes.title: See which quest rewards are upgrades
changes.text: When a quest lets you choose a reward, each one that’s an upgrade for your spec has an arrow, and the best has a gold one.

changes.title: Flight times on the flight map
changes.text: Pointing at a place on the flight map now shows how long the flight takes.
A route you’ve flown once is now timed from your own flight, and your guildmates’ flights help time routes you haven’t flown.
Fixed flights that pass through other towns showing a time up to a minute too long. A first flight on a long route can still be a few seconds out.
When you pick a slot, its list of upgrades now starts with the best one for you, even if you can’t wear it yet.
The Gear plan now opens faster, and its stat weights, level 60 sets and raid supplies are WoWSims’ newest.
Your guild’s results now show one row for each player, not one for each of their characters, once they’re on this version.
Your pal on screen can now be dragged right up to each edge.
Fixed a sleeping pal turning to follow your pointer.
Fixed the Gear plan, Dungeon guide and Crafting profit windows opening against the top of a smaller screen. They now open in the middle.

changes.title: Craft from your leveling path
changes.text: The current step on your profession leveling path has a Craft button. It makes that step’s items, or as many as your materials cover.

changes.title: Add one step to your shopping list
changes.text: Each step on your profession leveling path has a + that adds just that step’s materials to your shopping list.

changes.title: See how much better an item is
changes.text: An item’s tooltip now says how much of an upgrade it is over what you’re wearing, for example “+5% better than equipped”.

changes.title: Remove a row
changes.text: Rows you added yourself have an × that takes them off the list.
Materials you can craft yourself are now listed as something to make (“make 18”), with how many you already have, instead of something to buy.
Vendor prices now match what that vendor charges you, and leather in your bags counts toward the leather you still need.
When a step needs training, your leveling path names a trainer who can teach it. This works for every profession.
The gold “best for you” mark now goes to the biggest upgrade, and items that give percent crit or hit are scored correctly.
A unique ring or trinket is no longer suggested for both slots at once.
A weapon master’s page lists only the weapon skills that trainer teaches.
A new build always gets a name of its own, and a greyed-out Delete button explains why it can’t be used.
The Gear plan, Dungeon guide and Crafting profit windows shrink to fit smaller screens.
On RestedXP’s guide, a step now shows a quest tag even when the quest you pick up on it has none. It uses a quest the step has you complete.
Fixed your profession leveling path being steered by what was in your bags. With auction prices on, it now takes the cheapest route.
Fixed the shopping buttons on your leveling path adding the same materials twice.
Fixed your leveling path moving on before you had finished the step you were on.
Fixed the labels that show where an item comes from spilling outside their column.
Fixed the first line of the “New in” strip being cut off.

changes.title: Learn talents from the Build Planner
changes.text: The card for your next talent point has a Learn button. It asks before spending the point and tells you when it’s learned.

changes.title: See which build you follow
changes.text: The build you’re following is tagged, and with dual spec each spec’s build is tagged too.
Problem reports you’ve received are listed when you log in, and /jsal reports clear removes them.
Fixed the food reminder not coming back after you die and lose Well Fed.
Fixed pals overlapping in the wrong order. The one nearer the front is now drawn in front.
The Layers feature has been removed, because the game no longer lets addons read which layer you’re on.
